```{r}
# Core

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)   # survreg supports interval-censored Gaussian regression (Stata intreg analogue)
library(knitr)

# For clustered (Region_Period_Cluster_Unit) robust SEs

# install.packages("clubSandwich")  # if needed

library(clubSandwich)

```

```{r}
df <- read_excel("S1_file_combined.xlsx")

# Verify required columns exist (these match the Stata do-file for Model 1)

needed <- c("tr_nop","ncases","Region_Period_Cluster_Unit","Neolithic","Early_Bronze_Age","Middle_Bronze_Age","Late_Bronze_Age","Iron_Age")
stopifnot(all(needed %in% names(df)))

# Basic sanity checks

nrow(df)
summary(df$tr_nop)
table(df$tr_nop == 0, useNA = "ifany")
dplyr::n_distinct(df$Region_Period_Cluster_Unit)

```

```{r}
hist(df$tr_nop)
report::report_table(df$tr_nop)
hist(log(df$tr_nop), breaks = 20)
```


```{r}

upper_bound = -3

df_m1 <- df %>%
mutate(
tr_nop = as.numeric(tr_nop),
ncases = as.numeric(ncases),

# logs
ltr_nop  = log(tr_nop),
ltr_nop2 = ltr_nop,

# left-censor zeros at -3 (approx ln(0.05))
ltr_nop  = ifelse(tr_nop == 0, NA_real_, ltr_nop),
ltr_nop2 = ifelse(tr_nop ==  0, upper_bound,       ltr_nop2)


)

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
df_m1$ltr_nop[df_m1$tr_nop > 0],
df_m1$ltr_nop2[df_m1$tr_nop > 0],
check.attributes = FALSE
)))
```

```{r}
report::report_table(df_m1$tr_nop)
```


```{r}
m1 <- survreg(
Surv(ltr_nop, ltr_nop2, type = "interval2") ~ `Neolithic` + Early_Bronze_Age + Middle_Bronze_Age + Late_Bronze_Age + `Iron_Age`,
data    = df_m1,
dist    = "gaussian",
weights = ncases
)

summary(m1)

```


```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# align cluster IDs to the estimation sample
mf  <- model.frame(m1)
idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
cluster_used <- df_m1$Region_Period_Cluster_Unit[idx]

V_cl <- vcovCL(m1, cluster = cluster_used, type = "HC0")

# survreg has an extra scale parameter; coeftest expects betas only:
p <- length(coef(m1))
V_cl_beta <- V_cl[1:p, 1:p, drop = FALSE]

coeftest(m1, vcov. = V_cl_beta)

```



```{r}

performance::check_model(m1)

```




```{r}
# Data pieces
X <- model.matrix(~ Neolithic + Early_Bronze_Age + Middle_Bronze_Age + Late_Bronze_Age + Iron_Age, data = df)
y <- ifelse(df$tr_nop > 0, log(df$tr_nop), NA_real_)
cpoint <- -3
is_cens <- df$tr_nop == 0

# Stata-normalized aweights: sum(a)=N
N <- nrow(df)
a <- df$ncases
a <- a * N / sum(a)

loglik <- function(par) {
  beta <- par[1:ncol(X)]
  lns  <- par[ncol(X) + 1]
  s <- exp(lns)
  xb <- drop(X %*% beta)

  ll <- numeric(N)

  # uncensored (point): y observed exactly
  idx_u <- which(!is_cens)
  ru <- y[idx_u] - xb[idx_u]
  ll[idx_u] <- -0.5 * ( a[idx_u] * (ru^2) / (s^2) + log(2*pi) + 2*lns - log(a[idx_u]) )

  # left-censored at cpoint: y* <= cpoint
  idx_c <- which(is_cens)
  t <- (cpoint - xb[idx_c]) * sqrt(a[idx_c]) / s
  ll[idx_c] <- pnorm(t, log.p = TRUE)

  sum(ll)
}

# Fit MLE
start <- c(rep(0, ncol(X)), 0)  # betas=0, lnsigma=0
fit <- optim(start, fn = function(p) -loglik(p), method = "BFGS", hessian = TRUE)

par_hat <- fit$par
beta_hat <- par_hat[1:ncol(X)]
sigma_hat <- exp(par_hat[ncol(X)+1])
beta_hat
sigma_hat

```
